description: Bornes de Recharge pour Véhicules Électriques (IRVE) – Montreuil is a dataset listed in Montreuil Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Etalab. Depuis le décret n° 2017-26 du 12 janvier 2017, les données relatives à la localisation géographique et aux caractéristiques techniques des stations et des points de recharge de véhicules électriques ouverts au public doivent être publiées sur data.gouv.fr. Le format des données est défini par l’arrêté du 12 janvier 2017. Coverage: Montreuil. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are borne, électrique, voiture, recharge, véhicule. The portal shows 194 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-montreuil-fr-portal.
